subject.title: [Bug]: OpenClaw Tool Lifecycle / Gateway Recovery Field Report

question: For replay-unsafe post-tool continuation failures like this one, should OpenClaw prioritize resumable session-survival semantics, receipt-only diagnostics, or provider-specific handling?
rationale: The current safety behavior avoids blind replay, but changing it requires maintainer intent about when a side-effecting turn may be resumed or summarized without duplicating work.

options.title: Define session-survival recovery
options.body: Specify the durable run/session state needed to continue safely after completed tool work, then implement receipts as supporting diagnostics.

options.title: Add receipt-only diagnostics
options.body: Keep the current fail-closed behavior and expose last-tool receipts, timestamps, and failure reasons so operators can inspect manually.

options.title: Keep provider-specific handling
options.body: Treat this as a local Ollama/Gemma or backend-limit class unless a live current-main repro proves a generic recovery gap.

recommendation.title: Define session-survival recovery
recommendation.body: Specify the durable run/session state needed to continue safely after completed tool work, then implement receipts as supporting diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across the terminal classifier, completed-post-tool reply fix, and session outcome projection paths implicated here.
